title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘underlines that credible EU action requires a permanent C2 headquarters capable of planning, commanding and conducting missions and operations at the strategic, operational and tactical levels; reiterates its calls for progress towards a European command-and-control structure by enabling the EU Military Staff, if needed, to plan and coordinate autonomous European military operations with the armed forces of Member States; underscores that this strengthens the European pillar of NATO;’
